name: Barn Raising
description: Log cabin quilt blocks, each a bright center framed by rounds of light and dark logs, turned so the light and dark halves build concentric diamonds out from the middle.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { --li: @p(0, 1); --di: @p(0, 1); --lx: @match($(li) == 0, var(--color3), var(--color4)); --ly: @match($(li) == 0, var(--color4), var(--color3)); --dx: @match($(di) == 0, var(--color1), var(--color2)); --dy: @match($(di) == 0, var(--color2), var(--color1)); background: linear-gradient(180deg, @var(--ly) 0% 10%, @var(--lx) 10% 20%, @var(--ly) 20% 30%, @var(--lx) 30% 40%, transparent 40% 60%, @var(--dy) 60% 70%, @var(--dx) 70% 80%, @var(--dy) 80% 90%, @var(--dx) 90% 100%); -webkit-transform: rotate(@calc(90 * (1 + match((@x - floor(@X / 2) - 0.5) > 0, 1, 0) + match((@y - floor(@Y / 2) - 0.5) > 0, 1, 0) * (3 - 2 * match((@x - floor(@X / 2) - 0.5) > 0, 1, 0))) + 180 * ((floor(abs((@x - floor(@X / 2) - 0.5))) + floor(abs((@y - floor(@Y / 2) - 0.5)))) % 2))deg) scale(1.012); transform: rotate(@calc(90 * (1 + match((@x - floor(@X / 2) - 0.5) > 0, 1, 0) + match((@y - floor(@Y / 2) - 0.5) > 0, 1, 0) * (3 - 2 * match((@x - floor(@X / 2) - 0.5) > 0, 1, 0))) + 180 * ((floor(abs((@x - floor(@X / 2) - 0.5))) + floor(abs((@y - floor(@Y / 2) - 0.5)))) % 2))deg) scale(1.012); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 40%; top: 40%; width: 20%; height: 20%; background: @p(var(--color5), var(--color6)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(90deg, @var(--dx) 0% 10%, @var(--dy) 10% 20%, @var(--dx) 20% 30%, @var(--dy) 30% 40%, transparent 40% 60%, @var(--lx) 60% 70%, @var(--ly) 70% 80%, @var(--lx) 80% 90%, @var(--ly) 90% 100%); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--bowtie); clip-path: @var(--bowtie); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --bowtie: polygon(0% 0%, 50% 50%, 100% 0%, 100% 100%, 50% 50%, 0% 100%); } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
